text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE oncall — alerts for tenant `vanguard-inc` in eu-west: sustained 5xx spike > 15% over the last 10m. Automated mitigation failed. Please acknowledge and triage.

Maria (oncall): acked. I'm on it. No recent deploys from our side, anyone seeing infra churn?

Jon (eng-rt): Noted. I don't see a rollout in the last 3 hours. App logs show a lot of upstream connection resets starting at 15:04 UTC.

Li-Wei (network): I'm seeing increased packet drops to the dedicated pool gateway (dp-eu-vg-01). Possible transit-gw/BGP instability between fr-par and eu-west. Running `mtr` to targets now.

Asha (SRE Lead): P1. Maria, start customer comms. Li-Wei, prep warm capacity in eu-north1 and a DNS-weighted failover plan. We'll perform staged traffic steering. Jon, prepare proxy/nginx changes to accept warm pool endpoints.

Maria (oncall): Drafting comms: "We are actively investigating increased errors for your production traffic. Engineers have identified network instability and are implementing failover to warm capacity. No data loss expected. Next update in 15m." Posting to the customer channel now.

Support Escalations Bot: Created INC-2026-5732 and attached customer account `vanguard-inc`. Notifying vanguard-netops contact via PagerDuty.

Jon (eng-rt): From app view: `envoy` logs show `upstream connect error or connection reset by peer` across multiple backend nodes. CPU/memory look normal — points to network.

Maria (oncall): Running quick health check: `curl -sS https://metrics.internal/vanguard/health | jq .` -> many 502/504 entries. Will attach last 200 lines.

Maria (oncall): ```
kubectl logs -n vanguard svc/proxy -c envoy --since=10m | tail -n 200
[2026-03-15T15:05:12Z] error envoy upstream connect error, connection reset by peer
[2026-03-15T15:06:01Z] 502 response from upstream 10.2.6.45
... (truncated)
```

Li-Wei (network): Opening ticket with cloud provider for transit-gw/BGP flapping. Also provisioning warm nodes in eu-north1: `dp-eu-vg-warm-02`. ETA ~6 minutes for full registration.

Asha (SRE Lead): Plan: 1) Prepare warm pool and confirm LB targets healthy. 2) Lower DNS TTL if possible, then do weighted DNS shift (start 25% -> 50% -> 100%) 3) Validate downstream error rate and latency after each step. Maria own customer comms and status updates. Jon handle proxy config.

Jon (eng-rt): Pushing nginx/proxy changes — adding warm upstreams and ensuring certs in place. Commands: ```bash
# add warm upstream
sudo vi /etc/nginx/conf.d/vanguard-upstreams.conf
# test config
nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx
```

Maria (oncall): Current DNS TTL for customer private zone shows 300s. Vanguard uses a Route53 private hosted zone via their peering. Do we have delegated access? Support, can you reach out to their infra?

Support Escalations Bot: Contacting vanguard-netops via PagerDuty and email now.

vanguard-netops: Confirmed. We have credentials ready. We will perform weighted record changes on request; can do at T+10. We'll also lower TTL to 60s if you want.

Li-Wei (network): Warm pool is up: `dp-eu-vg-warm-02` healthy (4/4). Targets registered with LB: 10.2.8.10-12. Health checks passing.

Asha (SRE Lead): Execute staged shift. Maria & Jon verify path and health while I monitor metrics. Maria, set initial weight to 25% to warm.

Maria (oncall): Initiating weighted shift -> 25% warm via Route53 console (customer delegate did the change and confirmed).

Jon (eng-rt): Sending canary traffic at 200rps to warm endpoints. Proxy accepts traffic, TLS negotiation ok.

Maria (oncall): Observing error rate drop: 5xx reduced from 18% -> 4% within ~8 minutes. Latency stable. Proceeding to 50% per plan.

vanguard-netops: Weight adjusted to 50% as requested. Lowered TTL to 60s.

Jon (eng-rt): 5xx now ~0.6%. Rolling 100% if stable for 5m. Monitoring logs for any anomalies.

Maria (oncall): Customer update: "We've shifted a portion of your production traffic to warm capacity in eu-north1 while the network team investigates peering instability. Error rates have decreased and service performance is stable. We'll continue to monitor and share the root cause once available."

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INC-2026-5732 status updated: mitigation in progress — traffic steered to warm pool, metrics improving.

Li-Wei (network): Cloud provider acknowledged transit-gw issue — internal maintenance led to intermittent BGP flaps. They expect full recovery in ~45 minutes. They've advised to keep warm pool active for 2 hours after full restoration.

Asha (SRE Lead): Action items for post-incident: 1) Postmortem documenting timeline and decision to use customer-delegated DNS weight shift; 2) Review TTL and runbook for customer-managed DNS scenarios; 3) Verify autoscale config for warm pools (min instances); 4) Customer-facing RCA and timeline.

Maria (oncall): Preparing handoff to night oncall @Nico at EOD. Current metrics stable, will keep warm pool active. Final customer update going out in 20m.

Nico (night-oncall): Acked. I have context and will monitor thresholds (alert if 5xx > 1% or latency > 2s).

Maria (oncall): Final update sent to customer channel and INC updated. Closing on-call for now, moving to post-incident docs.

Asha (SRE Lead): Thanks team. Please include the exact Route53 change IDs and timestamps in the postmortem.

incident-bot: Log: incident thread closed by Maria (oncall) for handoff.
